title: MIRAGE: Multimodal Immersive Reasoning and Guided Exploration for Red-Team Jailbreak Attacks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differences in jailbreak Attack Success Rates (ASR) when the model is assigned various personas (e.g., Detective, Psychologist, Historian, Chemist, Engineer) to measure how task orientation and narrative completeness override the model's ethical constraints.

Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of multimodal jailbreak prompts specifically categorizing under 'Bias' and 'Hate Speech' within the RedTeam-2K dataset, evaluated using Perspective API toxicity scores and human review.
